set.st: A farmer plowed up Spanish and Mexican gold coins dated back to the 1700s in northern Weesaw Township. Old legend: a large sum buried there; Indians had searched in vain about 30 years earlier. Farmers neglected work to dig. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.pl: Sec. 11 T7S R19W, northern Weesaw Township (section centroid, provisional): the 1887 Berrien atlas township history places the finder "in Section 11" as an early settler; he is not on the 1873 or 1887 plats (likely a tenant)
set.t: Find the farm on an 1880s-1890s Berrien plat. Spot finds of 1700s gold suggest a scatter or a disturbed cache: grid the plowed field. Access: private farm: permission. Find dated about 22 Apr 1897 (coins dated 1700); the same spot had been searched about 30 years earlier.
